# Indexed Read Performance Fixture

`indexed.db` is generated by pinned SQLite 3.54.0 from `indexed.sql`.

The fixture contains 4,096 rows and three ordinary indexes:

- `items_category_score(category, score)` for unique-category equality,
  multi-column equality, and covering/noncovering access;
- `items_score_desc(score DESC)` for one- and two-sided range access; and
- `items_flag(flag)` with a deliberately unselective
  `sqlite_stat1` value of `4096 4096`.

The payload is a deterministic 128-byte BLOB whose first eight bytes encode
the row ID in lowercase hexadecimal. The database uses 4,096-byte pages,
DELETE journal mode, UTF-8, no auto-vacuum, application ID `1297305937`, and
user version `1`.

The canonical image is 843,776 bytes (206 pages) with SHA-256:

```text
3ec1f973ddd77bf931b51bdf1309b854e2d0b60166e0d153bba4f566307f4ea9
```

Regenerate it with:

```sh
python3 tools/index_performance.py create-fixture \
  --profile tests/compatibility/sqlite-oracle-profile-v1.json \
  --sqlite-library /absolute/path/to/libmodern_sqlite_benchmark_sqlite_shared \
  --sqlite-c /absolute/path/to/sqlite3.c \
  --sqlite-h /absolute/path/to/sqlite3.h \
  --sql tests/fixtures/index_performance/indexed.sql \
  --output /tmp/indexed.db
```
